Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for your offer. We want to continue with you as our main source for this bar: a binding 94,800 kg per year for 24 months, 189,600 kg in total; our monthly call-off schedule is attached.

On 2026-09-10 you quoted us EUR 5.45 per kg for this bar; your new quote is 11.0% above it.
Our orders for this bar rose from EUR 5.17 to EUR 5.45 within nine months (po:4500013278-10, po:4500013392-10, po:4500013795-10, po:4500014455-10).
Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Our demand forecast for this part is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

We propose three options, all 24 months without a price adjustment clause: EUR 4.73 at 45 days net, EUR 4.70 at 14 days net, or EUR 4.78 at 90 days net.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer. We move towards you: EUR 4.80 per kg, 14 days net, 24 months, no price adjustment clause.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
